# Amazon Redshift Data API

Run deterministic statement lifecycles against user-supplied fixture answers.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `redshiftdata` |
| Signing name | `redshift-data` |
| Wire protocol | AWS JSON 1.1 |
| API version | `2019-12-20` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Fixture-backed statements; no SQL engine |
| Selected operations | 7 of 12 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#amazon-redshift-data-api) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- No SQL parsing or execution, database catalog, ListDatabases/ListSchemas/ListTables/DescribeTable, sessions, synchronous execution or wait-time requests.
- WithEvent=true and RoleLevel selection are explicitly unsupported; no EventBridge query events or per-IAM-role statement ownership.
- CSV conversion uses fixture fields and metadata, not database-specific type formatting.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.

## Supported operations

The table is generated from the profile and pinned Smithy model. Routes show REST bindings or the standard
JSON/Query endpoint. RPC v2 CBOR uses its service/operation route, as described in
[protocol handling](../architecture/request-flow.md). Supported members are selected separately in the
[shape whitelist](https://github.com/amjadjibon/tinystack/blob/main/generator/model/profile.json); an enabled operation may reject unsupported options.

| Operation | HTTP binding |
| --- | --- |
| `BatchExecuteStatement` | `POST /` |
| `CancelStatement` | `POST /` |
| `DescribeStatement` | `POST /` |
| `ExecuteStatement` | `POST /` |
| `GetStatementResult` | `POST /` |
| `GetStatementResultV2` | `POST /` |
| `ListStatements` | `POST /` |
